description: Posts of one subreddit from Reddit's public feed, sorted hot, new, top or rising (about 25 items): id, title, author, date and link. The feed has no scores or comment counts, so it cannot rank by votes. Related tools on this server, for a different need: social_reddit_posts_comments when you need Reddit community discussions from Reddit's public RSS; social_reddit_profiles when you need Reddit user profile from Reddit's public user feed. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

sort.description: hot, new, top or rising (default hot)

subreddit.description: Subreddit name without r/ (2-21 letters, digits or _)
